Application Modules¶

Database Models¶

Database models for the Django News Application.

Defines publishers, users, articles, and newsletters.

The custom user model supports reader, journalist, and editor roles. Readers can subscribe to publishers and individual journalists. Articles support editorial approval before publication.

class news_app.models.Article(*args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Represents a news article.

Articles are written by journalists and can optionally belong to a publisher.

Forms¶

Forms for article publishing, newsletters, and user registration.

Provides journalist-specific field filtering and secure account registration with administrator-controlled editorial roles.

class news_app.forms.ArticleForm(*args, journalist=None, **kwargs)[source]¶

Bases: ModelForm

Form used by journalists to create and edit articles.

The author and approval status are deliberately excluded. The logged-in journalist becomes the author automatically, and only an editor can approve an article.

Website Views and API¶

Website views and REST API endpoints for the News Application.

Provides public article and newsletter pages, reader subscriptions, journalist publishing workflows, editor approval workflows, user registration, and role-based API permissions.

Approve an article through the website.

The save operation triggers the approval signal.

news_app.views.editor_dashboard(request)[source]¶

Display articles awaiting editor approval.

news_app.views.editor_review_article(request, pk)[source]¶

Allow an editor to review a pending article.

news_app.views.home(request)[source]¶

Public homepage.

Only approved articles are displayed.

news_app.views.journalist_create_article(request)[source]¶

Allow a journalist to submit a new article.

New articles always begin as unapproved and must be reviewed by an editor before publication.

news_app.views.journalist_create_newsletter(request)[source]¶

Allow journalists to create newsletters.

news_app.views.journalist_dashboard(request)[source]¶

Display articles and newsletters created by the logged-in journalist.

news_app.views.journalist_delete_article(request, pk)[source]¶

Allow journalists to delete only articles that they personally authored.

news_app.views.journalist_delete_newsletter(request, pk)[source]¶

Allow journalists to delete only newsletters that they personally created.

news_app.views.journalist_edit_article(request, pk)[source]¶

Allow a journalist to edit only an article that they personally authored.

Editing sends the article back for editorial review.

news_app.views.journalist_edit_newsletter(request, pk)[source]¶

Allow journalists to edit only newsletters that they personally created.

news_app.views.newsletter_list(request)[source]¶

Display available newsletters.

news_app.views.reader_dashboard(request)[source]¶

Display approved articles from publishers and journalists followed by the current reader.

news_app.views.reader_subscriptions(request)[source]¶

Allow readers to view available publishers and journalists and manage their subscriptions.
